body.purpose: Self-hosted regular/medium TTF, OFL notices preserved; --font-sans and --font-mono share the monospace stack. Body uses --font-size-root; controls keep Kit UI md sizes.

heading.purpose: 16px uppercase medium 500 wordmark, 20px line height; full-width sticky 72px navigation bar with 20px vertical padding and horizontal gutters aligned to the centered 1080px content column (20px on phones), based on OpenCode Data. Short paths 14px, footer 11px.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Kit UI color feedback; --press-transform:none prevents downward press movement.

motion.name: preview-disclosure
motion.purpose: Existing preview disclosure rotation; reduced motion suppresses animations/transitions.

components.name: Default Button
components.description: Direct Kit UI Button with default neutral/outline/md API. Natural desktop height is about 29px, square corners and IBM Plex Mono regular text; amber hover border, no pressed translation.

components.name: Danger Outline Button
components.description: Direct Kit UI Button with tone="danger" and default outline/md API. Neutral at rest and red-tinted on hover with amber border; no pressed translation. Deletion confirms inline.

components.name: Text and Search Inputs
components.description: Direct Kit UI TextInput/SearchInput, default md height 28px, square corners. One outer border recolors amber on focus; no outer or inner outline/shadow and no inner input border. Placeholders use --text-secondary.

components.name: Sort Dropdown
components.description: Direct Kit UI SelectDropdown, default md 26px desktop height, square tokens and IBM Plex Mono. Most used initially; Name available. Sorting remains in the toolbar; no downward press movement.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-sort" aria-label="Sort links" aria-haspopup="listbox" aria-expanded="false">Most used<svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></button>

components.name: Close Icon Button
components.description: Direct Kit UI IconButton with default neutral tone and md size closes the inline editor/import form. Accessible name describes the action; application CSS only sizes the glyph.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-close" aria-label="Close editor"><svg aria-hidden="true" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5"><path d="m6 6 12 12M6 18 18 6" stroke-linecap="round"/></svg></button>

components.name: Empty Directory
components.description: Direct Kit UI EmptyState within a square dashed default-border boundary. Keep empty directory and no matches distinct; never seed sample links.
components.html:

components.name: Link Table
components.description: Direct Kit UI Table and non-interactive TableHeaderCell. Static 1px gray wrapper border, striped rows and hover backgrounds; no hover border recoloring or outline. Short paths 14px, body cells 13px with 14px padding, headers 11px with 12px 14px padding. Wrapper scrolls internally on phones. Preview includes headers only, no invented records.
components.css: .ds-table-wrapper{overflow:auto;min-width:0;border:1px solid var(--border-default)}.ds-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:var(--bg-surface);font-family:var(--font-sans)}.ds-table th{padding:12px 14px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.04em;font-weight:400;text-align:left;color:var(--text-secondary);background:var(--bg-inset)}.ds-table td{padding:14px;font-size:13px;color:var(--text-secondary);border-bottom:1px solid var(--border-muted)}.ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even){background:var(--bg-inset)}.ds-table tbody tr:hover{background:var(--bg-surface-hover)}.ds-table .ds-visits{text-align:right;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}

components.name: Native Editor Fields
components.description: Native textarea/file fields use square token-based styling and a single existing border recolored amber on focus, with no outline/shadow. IBM Plex Mono matches the inline editor. Fields stack at 760px; actions/preview wrap at 400px. Inputs and selected files survive errors.

narrative.overview:
Charcoal Index is the approved OpenCode-inspired direction drawn from the local
Homelab Launcher: an operational short-link directory with IBM Plex Mono,
charcoal surfaces, square edges and restrained amber feedback. A compact title leads to search, New link and Sort above one table. Keep the directory
visible while editing. No sidebar, summary tiles or decorative dashboard cards.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal surfaces, amber focus and square zero-radius edges with no shadows.
Self-hosted IBM Plex Mono regular/medium; 16px uppercase wordmark in a 72px full-width sticky header, matching OpenCode Data navigation.
1080px centered content, compact Kit UI md controls and an internally scrolling table.
One fixed charcoal dark palette; no theme selection or saved appearance preferences.
dos: Use a single visible focus border for text fields.
Preserve default stripes and hover backgrounds without hover outlines or border color changes.
donts: No sidebar, summary tiles or decorative dashboard cards.
Do not add row hover border changes or arrow animations.
Never add a Refresh action or invented links.
